media/correlation-matrix-example.png.short: A correlation matrix showing pairwise correlations between 30 DJIA stocks, with values ranging from -1 to 1.
media/correlation-matrix-example.png.long: This is a correlation matrix showing the correlation coefficients between 30 DJIA stocks over 15 years, with values ranging from -1 to 1. The matrix contains 30 data series (one for each stock). The color scale at the bottom indicates that dark red represents -1 (perfect negative correlation), white represents 0 (no correlation), and dark blue represents 1 (perfect positive correlation). The average correlation is 0.21 as stated in the title. The matrix is symmetric, with the diagonal showing 1.0 for each stock's correlation with itself. The highest positive correlation observed is 0.87 (between JPM and GS), and the highest negative correlation observed is -0.69 (between CVX and AMZN). The matrix contains 900 correlation values in total, but not all can be precisely read due to the small size of the cells. The values range from approximately -0.7 to 0.9, with most values falling between -0.3 and 0.5.
media/correlation-matrix-example.png.source: Own illustration, data from Yahoo! Finance, 24.02.2026.
media/correlation-matrix-example.png.takeaway_default: This image demonstrates the low average correlation (0.21) between DJIA stocks over 15 years, showing that while some pairs have strong positive or negative correlations, most have weak correlations, which is important for understanding portfolio diversification.
media/correlation-matrix-example.png.short_de: Eine Korrelationsmatrix, die paarweise Korrelationen zwischen 30 Aktien des DJIA zeigt, wobei die Werte von -1 bis 1 reichen.
media/correlation-matrix-example.png.long_de: Dies ist eine Korrelationsmatrix, die die Korrelationskoeffizienten zwischen 30 DJIA-Aktien über einen Zeitraum von 15 Jahren darstellt, wobei die Werte von -1 bis 1 reichen. Die Matrix enthält 30 Datensätze (einen für jede Aktie). Die Farbskala am unteren Rand zeigt, dass dunkles Rot -1 (perfekte negative Korrelation) darstellt, Weiß 0 (keine Korrelation) und dunkles Blau 1 (perfekte positive Korrelation). Die durchschnittliche Korrelation beträgt 0,21, wie im Titel angegeben. Die Matrix ist symmetrisch, wobei die Diagonale für jede Aktie eine Korrelation von 1,0 mit sich selbst anzeigt. Die höchste beobachtete positive Korrelation beträgt 0,87 (zwischen JPM und GS), und die höchste beobachtete negative Korrelation beträgt -0,69 (zwischen CVX und AMZN). Die Matrix enthält insgesamt 900 Korrelationswerte, aber nicht alle können aufgrund der geringen Größe der Zellen präzise abgelesen werden. Die Werte reichen von etwa -0,7 bis 0,9, wobei die meisten Werte zwischen -0,3 und 0,5 liegen.
media/correlation-matrix-example.png.takeaway_default_de: Dieses Bild veranschaulicht die geringe durchschnittliche Korrelation (0,21) zwischen den Aktien des DJIA über einen Zeitraum von 15 Jahren. Es zeigt, dass zwar einige Aktienpaare eine starke positive oder negative Korrelation aufweisen, die meisten jedoch eine schwache Korrelation haben, was für das Verständnis der Portfoliodiversifizierung wichtig ist.

tikz:1gr-tikz.short: Diagram of a slide with its title bar, footer and the four margins drawn in.
tikz:1gr-tikz.long: A scaled-down slide outline. A dark title bar labelled \SMTitleBarBottomAlign across the top, a dark footer labelled \SMFooterBoxHeight along the bottom. Dashed blue lines mark the Top Margin (\SMContentTopAlign) below the title bar, the Bottom Margin (\SMContentBottomAlign) above the footer, and the Left and Right Margins near the edges; a bullet and a gray line stand for the first line of text, sitting on the Top Margin.
tikz:1gr-tikz.takeaway_default: The framework places content on fixed margins, which your own drawings can use too.

tikz:1t2-tikz.short: A small bar chart whose third, green bar appears only at reveal step 3.
tikz:1t2-tikz.long: Two blue bars of increasing height on a gray base line; from the third reveal step on, a taller green bar labelled "step 3" appears to their right, without moving the other two.
tikz:1t2-tikz.takeaway_default: A TikZ element can appear at a later step without moving the rest.

tikz:1u5-tikz.short: A small bar chart with one bar highlighted, a dotted guide line and an arrow labelled "peak".
tikz:1u5-tikz.long: Five blue bars of different heights. The fourth and tallest bar is enclosed in a red rounded rectangle (the gotham highlight style); a red dotted line (gotham dotted highlight) runs from the left to the top of that bar, and a red arrow (gotham arrow) labelled "peak" points at it from the upper left.
tikz:1u5-tikz.takeaway_default: The framework's TikZ styles mark a part of a chart.

tikz:1ym-tikz.short: Diagram: the LaTeX framework, your project and the SlideMage app, and the workflow from writing slides to handing out PDFs.
tikz:1ym-tikz.long: Three boxes side by side. "LaTeX framework: latex/: the Gotham theme, the base preamble, the templates" with an arrow to "Your project: any folder with a slide_ids.csv: slides, decks, images", and from the right "SlideMage: the app: compiles decks, manages IDs, versions, images, transcripts" with an arrow pointing to the project.
